scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from polar half-plane inequalities and exact corner areas; a 148-parameter exact rational independent formulation provides finite supplementary checks, not a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification applies to proper convex quadrilaterals in the plane only; the value 3/2 is a nonattained infimum, and no formula for polygons with more vertices is claimed. An equivalent older unindexed formula remains a literature possibility.
title: Exact Makai volume-product profile of convex quadrilaterals
